<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Yellow creature dance</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 244px; height: 240px; overflow: hidden; background: #ffffff; }
  canvas { display: block; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 244px; height: 240px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const W = 244, H = 240;
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true, antialias: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(W, H);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xffffff);

const CAM_Z = 10.29, CAM_Y = 2.41;
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(22, W / H, 0.1, 100);
camera.position.set(0, CAM_Y, CAM_Z);
camera.lookAt(0, CAM_Y, 0);

// ---------- Lights ----------
const hemi = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0xb89a78, 2.2); hemi.name = 'light-hemi'; scene.add(hemi);
const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 2.6); key.name = 'light-key'; key.position.set(3, 6, 10); scene.add(key);
const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff2dd, 1.0); fill.name = 'light-fill-left'; fill.position.set(-10, 2, 6); scene.add(fill);
const fillR = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.6); fillR.name = 'light-fill-right'; fillR.position.set(10, 2, -2); scene.add(fillR);
const back = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.8); back.name = 'light-back'; back.position.set(0, 5, -10); scene.add(back);

// ---------- Floor ----------
const environment = new THREE.Group();
environment.name = 'environment';
scene.add(environment);
{
  const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
  cv.width = 64; cv.height = 64;
  const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
  const gr = ctx.createRadialGradient(32, 32, 0, 32, 32, 32);
  gr.addColorStop(0.0, '#8c8c8c');
  gr.addColorStop(0.2, '#bdbdbd');
  gr.addColorStop(0.42, '#d6d6d6');
  gr.addColorStop(0.94, '#ffffff');
  gr.addColorStop(1.0, '#ffffff');
  ctx.fillStyle = gr;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(cv);
  tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  const floor = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(16, 16), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: tex }));
  floor.name = 'floor';
  floor.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
  environment.add(floor);
}

// ---------- Materials ----------
const YELLOW_TOP = '#ffd04a', YELLOW_LOW = '#ffc434', BELLY = '#e2c8ae';
const bodyMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.6, metalness: 0 });
const headMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: YELLOW_TOP, roughness: 0.6, metalness: 0 });
const armMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#ffb82a', roughness: 0.62, metalness: 0 });
const handMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#4a3620', roughness: 0.6, metalness: 0 });
const beakMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#f39a1f', roughness: 0.55, metalness: 0 });
const mouthMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#8a3a12', roughness: 0.7, metalness: 0 });
const eyeMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#0c0a08', roughness: 0.3, metalness: 0 });

const unitSphere = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 32, 24);
function ell(mat, sx, sy, sz, x, y, z, name) {
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(unitSphere, mat);
  m.scale.set(sx, sy, sz);
  m.position.set(x, y, z);
  if (name) m.name = name;
  return m;
}

// ---------- Character ----------
const character = new THREE.Group();
character.name = 'character-yellow-creature';
scene.add(character);

// rig: swaying / squashing upper body (torso + head)
const rig = new THREE.Group();
rig.name = 'upper-body-rig';
character.add(rig);

// torso twists around Y inside the rig
const bodyGroup = new THREE.Group();
bodyGroup.name = 'body';
rig.add(bodyGroup);
{
  const prof = [
    [0.00, 0.00], [0.02, 0.50], [0.14, 0.92], [0.45, 1.24], [0.90, 1.40],
    [1.45, 1.43], [2.00, 1.34], [2.40, 1.17], [2.80, 0.93], [3.10, 0.77],
    [3.35, 0.67], [3.60, 0.60], [3.85, 0.46], [4.00, 0.00]
  ];
  const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(prof.map(p => new THREE.Vector3(p[1], p[0], 0)), false, 'centripetal');
  const pts = curve.getPoints(140).map(v => new THREE.Vector2(Math.max(0, v.x), Math.max(0, v.y)));
  pts[0].set(0, 0);
  pts[pts.length - 1].x = 0;
  const geo = new THREE.LatheGeometry(pts, 128);
  const pos = geo.attributes.position;
  const colors = new Float32Array(pos.count * 3);
  const cTop = new THREE.Color(YELLOW_TOP), cLow = new THREE.Color(YELLOW_LOW);
  const cB = new THREE.Color(BELLY), c = new THREE.Color();
  for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) {
    const x = pos.getX(i), y = pos.getY(i), z = pos.getZ(i);
    let m = 0;
    if (z > 0) {
      const d = Math.hypot(x / 0.62, (y - 2.07) / 0.78);
      m = 1 - THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(d, 0.8, 1.08);
    }
    const h = THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(y, 1.2, 3.4);
    c.copy(cLow).lerp(cTop, h).lerp(cB, m);
    colors[i * 3] = c.r; colors[i * 3 + 1] = c.g; colors[i * 3 + 2] = c.b;
  }
  geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
  const torso = new THREE.Mesh(geo, bodyMat);
  torso.name = 'torso';
  bodyGroup.add(torso);
}

// Head
const HEAD_Y = 3.72;
const head = new THREE.Group();
head.name = 'head';
head.position.set(0, HEAD_Y, 0);
rig.add(head);
{
  const skull = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.62, 48, 32), headMat);
  skull.name = 'head-sphere';
  head.add(skull);

  const eyes = new THREE.Group();
  eyes.name = 'eyes';
  head.add(eyes);
  const zAxis = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1);
  [['eye-right', -1], ['eye-left', 1]].forEach(([name, s]) => {
    const g = new THREE.Group();
    g.name = name;
    const n = new THREE.Vector3(s * 0.27, 0.24, 0.504).normalize();
    g.position.copy(n).multiplyScalar(0.612);
    g.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(zAxis, n);
    g.add(ell(eyeMat, 0.064, 0.09, 0.035, 0, 0, 0, name + '-ball'));
    eyes.add(g);
  });

  const mouth = new THREE.Group();
  mouth.name = 'mouth';
  head.add(mouth);
  const upper = new THREE.Group();
  upper.name = 'beak-upper';
  upper.add(ell(beakMat, 0.24, 0.075, 0.22, 0, 0, 0, 'beak-upper-mesh'));
  upper.position.set(0, -0.07, 0.64);
  mouth.add(upper);
  const lower = new THREE.Group();
  lower.name = 'beak-lower';
  lower.add(ell(beakMat, 0.2, 0.055, 0.18, 0, 0, 0, 'beak-lower-mesh'));
  lower.position.set(0, -0.15, 0.6);
  mouth.add(lower);
  mouth.add(ell(mouthMat, 0.215, 0.022, 0.19, 0, -0.115, 0.615, 'mouth-line'));
}

// Arms (children of character; shoulders follow the rig + torso twist each frame)
const ARM_R = 0.25;
const limbGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(ARM_R, ARM_R, 1, 24, 1, true);
limbGeo.translate(0, 0.5, 0);
function makeArm(name, side) {
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  g.name = 'arm-' + name;
  const ball = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(ARM_R, 24, 16), armMat);
  ball.name = 'arm-' + name + '-shoulder';
  g.add(ball);
  const limb = new THREE.Mesh(limbGeo, armMat);
  limb.name = 'arm-' + name + '-limb';
  g.add(limb);
  const hand = new THREE.Group();
  hand.name = 'hand-' + name;
  hand.add(ell(armMat, ARM_R, ARM_R, ARM_R, 0, -0.06, 0, 'hand-' + name + '-wrist'));
  hand.add(ell(handMat, 0.28, 0.31, 0.27, 0, 0.03, 0, 'hand-' + name + '-fist'));
  hand.add(ell(handMat, 0.11, 0.15, 0.11, -side * 0.2, 0.02, 0.15, 'hand-' + name + '-thumb'));
  g.add(hand);
  g.userData = { limb, hand };
  return g;
}
const armRight = makeArm('right', -1); // viewer's left
const armLeft = makeArm('left', 1);    // viewer's right
character.add(armRight);
character.add(armLeft);
const shoulderR = new THREE.Vector3(-1.0, 2.0, 0.55);
const shoulderL = new THREE.Vector3(1.05, 2.05, 0.5);

// Feet
const feet = new THREE.Group();
feet.name = 'feet';
character.add(feet);
[['foot-right', -1], ['foot-left', 1]].forEach(([name, s]) => {
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  g.name = name;
  g.position.set(s * 0.55, 0.14, 0.85);
  g.add(ell(armMat, 0.42, 0.14, 0.55, 0, 0, 0, name + '-mesh'));
  feet.add(g);
});

// ---------- Animation keys ----------
const PERIOD = 1200;
const T = [0, 160, 340, 500, 680, 840, 1020, 1180];

// pixel position (in the reference view) + depth -> world [x, y, z]
function px(x, y, z) {
  const f = (CAM_Z - z) / CAM_Z / 60;
  return [(x - 122) * f, CAM_Y + (120 - y) * f, z];
}
// character's right hand (viewer's left)
const rKeys = [
  [-0.83, 2.90, 0.78],
  px(18, 72, 0.5),
  px(55, 105, 0.85),
  px(22, 109, 0.5),
  px(22, 100, 0.5),
  px(60, 95, 0.85),
  px(18, 90, 0.5),
  px(47, 108, 0.85)
];
// character's left hand (viewer's right)
const lKeys = [
  [1.40, 3.04, 0.6],
  px(156, 98, 1.1),
  px(207, 100, 0.6),
  px(185, 126, 1.1),
  px(168, 105, 1.1),
  px(210, 95, 0.6),
  px(165, 100, 1.1),
  px(208, 105, 0.6)
];
// body: [head dx px, head dy px (down), torso twist yaw rad, hip sway px]
const hKeys = [
  [0, 0, 0.08, 2],
  [-2, 6, -0.12, -3],
  [0, 4, 0.07, 2],
  [2, 9, -0.12, -3],
  [4, 5, -0.08, -3],
  [0, 1, 0.07, 2],
  [4, 5, -0.09, -3],
  [1, 10, 0.09, 2]
];

function sample(keys, t) {
  t = ((t % PERIOD) + PERIOD) % PERIOD;
  let i = T.length - 1;
  for (let k = 0; k < T.length; k++) { if (t >= T[k]) i = k; }
  const j = (i + 1) % T.length;
  const t1 = (j === 0) ? PERIOD : T[j];
  let u = (t - T[i]) / (t1 - T[i]);
  u = u * u * (3 - 2 * u);
  const a = keys[i], b = keys[j], out = [];
  for (let k = 0; k < a.length; k++) out.push(a[k] + (b[k] - a[k]) * u);
  return out;
}

const UP = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);
const vS = new THREE.Vector3(), vD = new THREE.Vector3();
function poseArm(arm, shoulderLocal, yaw, hp) {
  vS.copy(shoulderLocal).applyAxisAngle(UP, yaw).applyMatrix4(rig.matrix);
  arm.position.copy(vS);
  vD.set(hp[0], hp[1], hp[2]).sub(vS);
  const len = Math.max(0.2, vD.length());
  vD.normalize();
  arm.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(UP, vD);
  arm.userData.limb.scale.set(1, len, 1);
  arm.userData.hand.position.set(0, len, 0);
}

const EYE_H = 3.95;
function render(t) {
  const hk = sample(hKeys, t);
  const s = 1 - (hk[1] / 60) / EYE_H;
  const k = 1 / Math.sqrt(s);
  const sway = hk[3] / 60;
  const rel = hk[0] / 60 - sway;           // head offset relative to the hips
  rig.scale.set(k, s, k);
  rig.position.set(sway, 0, 0);
  rig.rotation.set(0, 0, -(0.35 * rel) / EYE_H);
  bodyGroup.rotation.y = hk[2];
  head.position.set((0.65 * rel) / k, HEAD_Y, 0);
  rig.updateMatrix();
  poseArm(armRight, shoulderR, hk[2], sample(rKeys, t));
  poseArm(armLeft, shoulderL, hk[2], sample(lKeys, t));
  scene.updateMatrixWorld(true);
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}
render(0);

window.nwb = {
  scene,
  renderer,
  cameras: { ref: camera },
  characters: [character],
  render,
  ready: true
};
</script>
</body>
</html>
